show.description: In a remote mountain race, a female cyclist is murdered—her killer vanishing without a trace. Months later, her sister infiltrates the same team as a journalist in disguise, chasing justice on two wheels. But as secrets unravel and allies turn shadows, one question remains: who truly helped her… and at what cost?
